# TeleBot — Full Documentation

> A modern Telegram bot framework for PHP 8.2+. Provides a clean, intuitive API for the Telegram Bot API with DTO objects, update handling, and testing utilities.

---

## Installation

Install via Composer:

```bash
composer require westacks/telebot
```

**Requirements:** PHP 8.2+, Latest Telegram Bot API

### Framework Integration

Adapter packages for seamless framework integration:
- [Laravel](https://github.com/westacks/telebot-laravel)

### Basic Example

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\TeleBot;

$bot = new TeleBot('YOUR_BOT_TOKEN');
$bot->getMe();
```

---

## Configuration

### Single Bot

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\TeleBot;

$bot = new TeleBot([
    'token' => 'YOUR_BOT_TOKEN', // Required
    'name' => 'MyBot'
]);
```

### Multiple Bots

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\BotManager;

$bot = new BotManager([
    'primary' => new TeleBot('YOUR_BOT1_TOKEN'),
    'secondary' => ['token' => 'YOUR_BOT2_TOKEN', 'name' => 'MyBot2'],
], 'secondary'); // 'secondary' is the default

$bot->getMe(); // Uses secondary bot
$bot->bot('primary')->getMe(); // Uses primary bot
```

### Bot Configuration Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|-----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `token` | `string` | Yes | — | Telegram bot token |
| `name` | `string` | No | `null` | Bot username for command parsing |
| `api_url` | `string` | No | Telegram API URL | Custom API endpoint |
| `http` | `array` | No | `[]` | Custom Guzzle HTTP client options |
| `kernel` | `string\|array` | No | `Kernel::class` | Kernel for update handling or array of handlers |
| `storage` | `string` | No | `FileStorage::class` | Storage driver for user states |

---

## Objects (DTOs)

The library provides DTO representations for all Telegram API types. Each sub-object is automatically cast to its appropriate DTO class.

### Interactions

```php
// Standard chaining
$chatId = $update->message->from->id;

// Dot notation (safe, readable)
$chatId = $update->get('message.from.is_bot');

// Iterating over properties
foreach ($update->message->from as $prop => $value) {
    echo "$prop => $value\n";
}

// JSON representation
$jsonUpdate = $update->toJson();

// Array representation
$arrayUpdate = $update->toArray();
```

---

## Methods

Execute all Telegram Bot API methods using named arguments or array syntax:

```php
// Named arguments
$message = $bot->sendMessage(
    chat_id: 1234567890,
    text: 'Test message',
);

// Array syntax
$message = $bot->sendMessage([
    'chat_id' => 1234567890,
    'text' => 'Test message',
]);
```

### Guzzle Promises

```php
$promise = $bot->getMe(_promise: true);
$promise->then(fn (User $user) => var_dump($user))->wait();
```

### Error Handling

```php
$result = $bot->getMe(_rescue: fn (\Throwable $e) => $e);
```

### TeleBot Helper Methods

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `handle(Update $update): mixed` | Handle a Telegram Update using registered handlers |
| `handler($handler): self` | Register a new update handler |
| `purge(): void` | Recreate bot kernel (remove all handlers) |
| `setLocalCommands(): bool` | Push locally registered bot commands to Telegram |
| `deleteLocalCommands(): bool` | Remove registered commands from Telegram |

### BotManager Methods

| Method | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `bot(string\|int $name): TeleBot` | Get a specific TeleBot instance by name |
| `bots(): array` | Get a list of registered bot names |
| `add(string\|int $name, ...): self` | Add a bot instance |
| `remove(string\|int $name): self` | Remove a bot by name |
| `default(string\|int $name): self` | Set the default bot |

---

## Handling Updates

Updates pass through a pipeline of registered handlers. Each handler checks if it should handle the update and may optionally stop further processing.

### Using Closures

```php
$handler = function (TeleBot $bot, Update $update, $next) {
    if ($update->message->text === '/start') {
        return $bot->sendMessage(
            chat_id: $update->chat()->id,
            text: 'Hello, World!'
        );
    }
    return $next();
};
```

### Using UpdateHandler Class

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\UpdateHandler;

class YourUpdateHandler extends UpdateHandler
{
    public function trigger(): bool
    {
        return $this->update->type('message');
    }

    public function handle()
    {
        return $this->sendMessage(text: 'Hello, World!');
    }
}
```

### Registering Handlers

```php
$bot = new TeleBot([
    'token' => '<your bot token>',
    'kernel' => [\App\YourUpdateHandler::class, $handler],
]);

// Or add later
$bot->handler(\App\YourUpdateHandler::class);
$bot->handler($handler);
```

### Custom Kernel

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Kernel as TeleBotKernel;
use WeStacks\TeleBot\TeleBot;

class Kernel extends TeleBotKernel
{
    public function __construct()
    {
        parent::__construct([\App\YourUpdateHandler::class]);
    }

    public function setCommands(TeleBot $bot)
    {
        return $bot->setMyCommands([
            'commands' => $this->getLocalCommands(),
            'scope' => 'default',
        ]);
    }

    public function deleteCommands(TeleBot $bot)
    {
        return $bot->deleteMyCommands(['scope' => 'default']);
    }
}
```

### Bot Commands (CommandHandler)

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\CommandHandler;

class StartCommand extends CommandHandler
{
    protected static function aliases(): array
    {
        return ['/start', '/s'];
    }

    protected static function description(?string $locale = null): string
    {
        return trans('Start the bot', locale: $locale);
    }

    public function handle()
    {
        return $this->sendMessage(['text' => 'Hello, World!']);
    }
}
```

Register commands on Telegram:
```php
$bot->setLocalCommands();
$bot->deleteLocalCommands();
```

### Requesting User Input (RequestInputHandler)

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\RequestInputHandler;

class AskNameHandler extends RequestInputHandler
{
    public function handle()
    {
        $data = $this->update->message()->toArray();
        $validator = Validator::make($data, [
            'text' => 'required|string|max:255',
        ]);

        if ($validator->fails()) {
            return $this->sendMessage(['text' => 'Invalid input!']);
        }

        $this->accept();
        $name = $validator->validated()['text'];

        return $this->sendMessage(['text' => "Hello, $name!"]);
    }
}
```

Request input:
```php
$handler = function ($bot, $update, $next) {
    if ('/test' !== $update->message()->text ?? null) {
        return $next();
    }
    AskNameHandler::request($bot, $update->user());
    return $bot->sendMessage([
        'chat_id' => $update->chat()->id,
        'text' => 'Please, type your name.',
    ]);
};
```

### Custom State Storage

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\StorageContract;

class DatabaseStorage implements StorageContract
{
    public function get(string $key, $default = null): mixed
    {
        return User::where('telegram_id', $key)->value('input_state') ?? $default;
    }

    public function set(string $key, $value): bool
    {
        return User::where('telegram_id', $key)->update(['input_state' => $value]);
    }

    public function delete(string $key): bool
    {
        return $this->set($key, null);
    }
}
```

Usage:
```php
$bot = new TeleBot([
    'token' => '<your bot token>',
    'storage' => \App\DatabaseStorage::class,
]);
```

### Callback Queries (CallbackHandler)

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\CallbackHandler;

class ButtonPressHandler extends CallbackHandler
{
    protected string $match = "/^test:(delete|update):(\d+)$/";

    public function handle()
    {
        [$action, $id] = $this->arguments();

        match ($action) {
            'update' => $this->update($id),
            'delete' => $this->delete($id),
        };

        $this->answerCallbackQuery();
    }
}
```

### Webhook

```php
$bot->setWebhook(['url' => 'https://example.com/webhook.php']);
$bot->handle(Update::from(file_get_contents('php://input')));
```

### Polling

```php
foreach ($bot->poll() as $update) {
    $bot->handle($update);
}
```

---

## Testing

Use the `fake()` method to simulate Telegram API responses:

```php
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\TeleBotResponse;
use WeStacks\TeleBot\Objects;

$bot->fake([
    TeleBotResponse::make(Objects\Message::from([
        'message_id' => 2,
        'date' => 1,
        'chat' => ['id' => 1, 'type' => 'private'],
        'text' => 'Please enter your name.',
    ])),
    TeleBotResponse::make(Objects\Message::from([
        'message_id' => 4,
        'date' => 2,
        'chat' => ['id' => 1, 'type' => 'private'],
        'text' => "Sorry, I don't know you.",
    ])),
    TeleBotResponse::make(Objects\Message::from([
        'message_id' => 6,
        'date' => 4,
        'chat' => ['id' => 1, 'type' => 'private'],
        'text' => 'Hello, John!',
    ])),
]);

$bot->handler(AskNameHandler::class);
$bot->handler(function (TeleBot $bot, Objects\Update $update, callable $next) {
    // handler logic
});

$res = $bot->handle($initialUpdate);
expect($res)->toBeInstanceOf(Objects\Message::class);
expect($res->text)->toBe('Please enter your name.');
```

---

## Upgrade from 3.x to 4.x

### Configuration Changes

| Old key | New key | Description |
|---------|---------|-------------|
| `storage` | `storage` | `JsonStorage` deprecated, use `FileStorage` |
| `handlers` | `kernel` | Kernel preferred over array; config key renamed |
| `exceptions` | — | Deprecated. Exceptions always thrown by default |
| `async` | — | Deprecated. Methods always called synchronously |

### BotManager Constructor

**Old (3.x):**
```php
new BotManager([
    'default' => 'primary',
    'bots' => [
        'primary' => new TeleBot('TOKEN1'),
        'secondary' => ['token' => 'TOKEN2'],
    ],
]);
```

**New (4.x):**
```php
new BotManager([
    'primary' => new TeleBot('TOKEN1'),
    'secondary' => ['token' => 'TOKEN2'],
], 'primary');
```

### Namespace Changes

| Old (3.x) | New (4.x) |
|-----------|-----------|
| `WeStacks\TeleBot\Handlers\UpdateHandler` | `WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\UpdateHandler` |
| `WeStacks\TeleBot\Handlers\RequestInputHandler` | `WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\RequestInputHandler` |
| `WeStacks\TeleBot\Handlers\CommandHandler` | `WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\CommandHandler` |
| `WeStacks\TeleBot\Handlers\CallbackHandler` | `WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\CallbackHandler` |
| `WeStacks\TeleBot\Contracts\StorageContract` | `WeStacks\TeleBot\Foundation\StorageContract` |

### TeleBot Method Changes

| Old (3.x) | New (4.x) | Description |
|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| `handleUpdate` | `handle` | Renamed |
| `addHandler` | `handler` | Renamed |
| `clearHandlers` | `purge` | Renamed |
| `config` | — | Deprecated. Use read-only property |
| `async` | — | Deprecated. Use `_promise` parameter |
| `exceptions` | — | Deprecated. Use `_rescue` parameter |

### BotManager Method Changes

| Old (3.x) | New (4.x) | Description |
|-----------|-----------|-------------|
| `delete` | `remove` | Renamed |

### RequestInputHandler Changes

| Old (3.x) | New (4.x) |
|-----------|-----------|
| `requestInput` | `request` |
| `acceptInput` | `accept` |

---

*Full documentation available at https://github.com/westacks/telebot*
